result.instructions: Tools for Rentec Direct, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my properties are vacant right now?"; "List the open work orders for 12 Elm Street and their status."; "Show the leases that end in the next 60 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rentec Direct data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rentecdirect_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rentecdirect_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rentecdirect_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rentecdirect_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rentecdirect_ping
tools.title: Check connection
tools.description: Check that the API key works. Returns the Rentec Direct user id and company the key belongs to. Rentec Direct API: GET /ping.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List properties with address, rent, deposit, owner and occupancy. Filter to occupied or vacant properties. Rentec Direct API: GET /properties.

occupied.description: true = only occupied, false = only vacant. Omit for all.

sub_of.description: Only subunits of this parent property id.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age: "30d" (days), "15m" (minutes) or "45s" (seconds). No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Get one property by its integer id, including its renters and subunits. Rentec Direct API: GET /properties/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_tenants
tools.title: List tenants
tools.description: List tenants with contact details and balance. Requires the read:tenants permission. Rentec Direct API: GET /tenants.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_tenant
tools.title: Get a tenant
tools.description: Get one tenant by its id (renter_id), including properties and balance. Rentec Direct API: GET /tenants/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_leases
tools.title: List leases
tools.description: List leases with move-in and move-out dates, lease term, recurring rent and balances. Rentec Direct API: GET /leases.

property_id.description: Only leases for this property id.

renter_id.description: Only leases for this tenant id (renter_id).

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_lease
tools.title: Get a lease
tools.description: Get one lease by its id (lease_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /leases/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_work_orders
tools.title: List work orders
tools.description: List maintenance work orders with status, property, vendor, priority and cost. Status codes: OpenU (unassigned), OpenA (assigned), Parts, Work, Finalized, Closed. Rentec Direct API: GET /work_orders.

status.description: Status code, e.g. OpenU, OpenA, Parts, Work, Finalized or Closed.

property_id.description: Only work orders for this property id.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_work_order
tools.title: Get a work order
tools.description: Get one work order by its id (workorder_id), with notes. Rentec Direct API: GET /work_orders/{id}.

work_order_id.description: The work order id (workorder_id from rentecdirect_list_work_orders).

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List ledger transactions (payments, charges, expenses) with amount, category, property and date. Results are paged, 300 per page. Rentec Direct API: GET /transactions.

property_id.description: Only transactions for this property id.

renter_id.description: Only transactions for this tenant id (renter_id).

bank_id.description: Only transactions for this bank account id.

category_id.description: Only transactions in this category id.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (300 records per page). Default 1.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_owners
tools.title: List owners
tools.description: List property owners with contact details and balance. Rentec Direct API: GET /owners.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_owner
tools.title: Get an owner
tools.description: Get one owner by its id (owner_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /owners/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (contractors and service providers) with contact details and rate. Rentec Direct API: GET /vendors.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

age.description: Filter by age, e.g. "30d", "12h", "15m", "45s". No unit means days.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_vendor
tools.title: Get a vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by its id (vendor_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /vendors/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_create_work_order
tools.title: Create a work order
tools.description: Create a maintenance work order for a property. This writes a new record to the account. Optional: tenant, vendor, status, priority 1-5, cost. Does not send e-mail. Rentec Direct API: POST /work_orders.

property_id.description: The property the work order is for (property_id).

renter_id.description: Tenant id (renter_id) who reported the issue.

vendor_id.description: Vendor id (vendor_id) assigned to the work.

tenant_view.description: Show the work order to the tenant in the portal.

owner_view.description: Show the work order to the owner in the portal.
